author: Derlisn
quote: The freedom and originality that once defined GTA are gone. The so-called “woke” agenda, which has already taken a devastating toll on the film industry, is now ruining the video game industry as well.There’s no longer any room for satire or for making fun of different groups. Nothing feels genuinely funny anymore, and the irreverent humor that once made GTA unique has all but disappeared. Prostitution, a recurring element in previous installments, is gone. You can no longer target members of so-called “protected” groups, and the iconic Rampage missions are nowhere to be found.What we’re left with is a sanitized, painfully boring experience built around a soulless, spineless protagonist with absolutely no personality. The female character is obnoxious, unlikeable, and seemingly clueless, yet somehow she’s the one calling the shots. Seriously?What a massive disappointment. This is a far cry from the bold, unapologetic, and genuinely entertaining GTA that made the franchise legendary.
